calendarid.description: Default calendar identifier used by read streams; use primary for the authenticated user primary calendar.

event_id.description: Event identifier used by the event and event_instances read streams.

rule_id.description: ACL rule identifier used by the acl_rule read stream.

setting.description: Setting identifier used by the setting read stream.

start_date.description: Lower bound for events.updated incremental reads.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID; treated as secret for conservative redaction parity.
